name: cg_coin_tickers
description:
Exchange markets where one coin trades, from CoinGecko (coins/{id}/tickers): each pair's exchange, last price, volume, bid-ask spread and trust score.
Returns {name, tickers: [{base, target, market {name, identifier}, last, volume, converted_last, converted_volume, bid_ask_spread_percentage, trust_score, trade_url, ...}]}; CoinGecko pages the list (first page only).
Inputs (* required): id* (string, CoinGecko coin id such as bitcoin or ethereum, not the ticker symbol; ids come from cg_search or cg_coin_list).
For all pairs on one exchange use cg_exchange_tickers.
Example: {"id": "bitcoin"}

id.description: CoinGecko coin id (e.g. bitcoin, ethereum), not the ticker symbol
